executiveSummary: Diplomacy & National (22 Nov): Home Minister Saifuddin confirms Pardons Board minutes on Najib Razak’s house arrest claim have been declassified for AGC court affidavit.
Bursa & Economy (22 Nov): Economy Minister Akmal Nasrullah outlines four 13th Malaysia Plan (13MP) healthcare priorities including a national health fund and 2027 base medical plan.
World & Tech (22 Nov): COP31 enters double overtime in Turkey; Anthropic’s Claude assists in formal Lean-verified proof of the Riemann hypothesis while Nasdaq erases 2026 gains (-12%).
Malaysia Economy (18–20 Nov): BNM reports Malaysia Q3 2026 GDP grew 5.5% on AI tech export surge; PM Anwar secures RM9.2b in indicative Chinese high-tech investments at APEC Shenzhen.

stories.headline: Pardons Board minutes on Najib’s house arrest bid declassified for court affidavit, says Saifuddin
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 22 — Home Minister Datuk Seri Saifuddin Nasution Ismail confirmed that the Federal Territories Pardons Board meeting minutes regarding Datuk Seri Najib Razak’s alleged house arrest addendum were declassified so the AGC could file its affidavit-in-reply.
takeaways: Declassified specifically for the Attorney-General's Chambers response to the Malaysian Bar's judicial review.
Clarifies official procedural steps surrounding the supplementary royal addendum dispute.

stories.headline: 13th Malaysia Plan outlines four healthcare reform priorities and 2027 base medical insurance plan
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 22 — Economy Minister Akmal Nasrullah Mohd Nasir unveiled four strategic healthcare pillars under the 13th Malaysia Plan (13MP), including sustainable health financing, a national health fund, and a base medical insurance plan by early 2027.
takeaways: Addresses surging private healthcare and medical insurance premium inflation across Malaysia.
Establishes a national health fund framework and standardized base medical plan by early 2027.

stories.headline: Fadillah: Sarawak’s MA63 rights push must balance state ambitions with stability of the Federation
stories.summary: KUCHING, Nov 22 — Deputy Prime Minister Datuk Seri Fadillah Yusof reminded stakeholders that Sarawak’s negotiations to reclaim rights under the Malaysia Agreement 1963 (MA63) must balance regional ambitions with the fiscal stability of the Federation.
takeaways: Emphasizes constructive federal-state negotiation channels under the MA63 technical committee.
Calls for mutual respect between Sarawak's constitutional rights and national cohesion.

stories.headline: Penang PH-Umno partnership should remain intact until end of current term, says CM Chow Kon Yeow
stories.summary: GEORGE TOWN, Nov 22 — Penang Chief Minister Chow Kon Yeow affirmed that the Pakatan Harapan (PH)-Umno state cooperation will continue through the end of the current term, dismissing criticism from local PKR backbenchers.
takeaways: Dismissed calls by Pantai Jerejak assemblyman Fahmi Zainol to review Umno's state appointments.
Stressed state administrative stability takes priority over partisan friction.

stories.headline: MCA Youth calls for revival of local council elections starting with Federal Territories
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 22 — Speaking at the MCA Youth general assembly, wing chief Ling Tian Soon urged Putrajaya to revive local government elections starting in Kuala Lumpur and the Federal Territories.
takeaways: Proposes piloting municipal elections in the Federal Territories to strengthen urban governance.
Proposal drew immediate pushback from Umno Youth leadership.

stories.headline: KL police launch manhunt after viral daylight cable heist outside TREC on Jalan Tun Razak
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 22 — Kuala Lumpur police initiated a manhunt for suspects filmed cutting and hauling utility cables using two vehicles in broad daylight outside the TREC entertainment hub on Jalan Tun Razak.
takeaways: Viral video footage captured suspects extracting cables along a busy stretch of Jalan Tun Razak.
Police are tracking vehicle registration details and nearby CCTV feeds.

stories.headline: Pokémon RUN 30 Malaysia kicks off at KLCC Plaza drawing thousands of runners and families
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 22 — The Pokémon RUN 30 Malaysia anniversary fun run and festival zone kicked off at KLCC Plaza, bringing thousands of runners and families to the city centre.
takeaways: Celebrates the 30th anniversary of the franchise with themed routes and interactive zones.
Boosted weekend retail and tourism foot traffic across the KLCC precinct.

stories.headline: UN COP31 climate summit in Antalya stalls into double overtime over draft omitting fossil-fuel phaseout
stories.summary: ANTALYA, Nov 22 — The UN COP31 climate talks in Antalya, Turkey entered double overtime after a draft proposal by COP31 President Murat Kurum omitted explicit timelines to transition away from coal, oil, and gas.
takeaways: Climate-vulnerable and African delegates accused oil-producing blocs of holding the text hostage.
Negotiators worked through the weekend to salvage a compromise climate finance and mitigation deal.

stories.headline: China pledges $20 million fund for practical APEC cooperation on green tech and digital trade
stories.summary: SHENZHEN, Nov 22 — Following the close of the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting in Shenzhen, China unveiled a $20 million cooperation fund targeting cross-border data flows, green technology, and digital economy integration.
takeaways: Supports multilateral technical frameworks agreed during the Shenzhen APEC summit.
Focuses on supply-chain digitization and regional clean-energy standards.

stories.headline: Anthropic’s Claude assists in formal Lean-verified proof of 19th-century Riemann Hypothesis
stories.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, Nov 22 — Anthropic announced that mathematician Levent Alpöge used the Claude AI model over a six-week sprint to help solve the 1859 Riemann hypothesis, with the formal proof verified in Lean.
takeaways: Independent verification completed by the Lean Focused Research Organization and Mathlib Initiative.
Marks a historic breakthrough in AI-assisted formal mathematics.

stories.headline: Google expands evolved Duplex AI agent architecture into Gemini app for autonomous business calls
stories.summary: MOUNTAIN VIEW, Nov 22 — Google announced the integration of its next-generation Duplex architecture into tasks inside the Gemini app, allowing personal AI agents to autonomously place phone calls and coordinate bookings.
takeaways: Enables end-to-end voice coordination with local businesses directly from Gemini task prompts.
Includes real-time user confirmation controls and transcript logging.

stories.headline: CoreWeave’s $47B debt build-out draws market scrutiny amid global AI data-centre spending anxiety
stories.summary: NEW YORK, Nov 22 — Financial analysts flagged mounting credit risks across leveraged AI cloud infrastructure providers, highlighting CoreWeave’s $47 billion debt load and heavy capital burn rate.
takeaways: Raises questions over long-term utilization rates if enterprise AI software revenues lag hardware capex.
Contributed to broader risk-off sentiment across AI hardware and data-centre equities.

stories.headline: Nasdaq erases all 2026 gains (-12% from peak) as S&P 500 and Dow enter formal correction territory
stories.summary: NEW YORK, Nov 22 — Wall Street wrapped up its sharpest weekly decline of the year, with the S&P 500 and Dow falling more than 10% from their record highs and the Nasdaq dropping 12% from its recent peak.
takeaways: Double-digit weekly declines in Nvidia, Micron, and SanDisk led the tech sector pullback.
Trillions in equity value erased, impacting tech-heavy 401(k) and retirement portfolios.

stories.headline: Taiwan’s Financial Supervisory Commission imposes blanket short-selling curbs to stem tech rout
stories.summary: TAIPEI, Nov 22 — Taiwan’s Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) enacted emergency restrictions on short-selling after heavy foreign sell-offs hit TSMC and domestic AI hardware supply-chain stocks.
takeaways: Rare market intervention aims to stabilize the Taiex following Wall Street's AI-led correction.
Restricts daily short-sale volumes and tightens margin collateral rules.

stories.headline: Gold slides to multi-month low near $3,655/oz as U.S. Dollar Index holds firm at 103.5
stories.summary: LONDON, Nov 22 — Gold extended a multi-week retreat to trade near $3,650–$3,660 an ounce as a strong U.S. dollar (DXY ~103.5) and hawkish Federal Reserve expectations weighed on bullion.
takeaways: Investors rotated out of equities and bullion into U.S. Treasury bonds, pushing bond yields lower.
Markets are closely watching Fed Gov. Christopher Waller's remarks ahead of the December rate decision.

stories.headline: European Union weighs dedicated digital tax on Big Tech conglomerates to fund long-term EU budget
stories.summary: BRUSSELS, Nov 22 — European Union policymakers are evaluating a dedicated digital levy on the world’s largest technology conglomerates to help finance the bloc’s upcoming long-term budget framework.
takeaways: Proposal aims to offset rising EU defense, industrial competitiveness, and research outlays.
Expected to face trade pushback from Washington.

stories.headline: NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope captures rejuvenated stellar merger supergiant 'Bao' in Andromeda
stories.summary: BALTIMORE, Nov 22 — The James Webb Space Telescope revealed detailed infrared imagery of a cosmic collision in the Andromeda galaxy where a supergiant 18,000 times brighter than the Sun swallowed a companion star.
takeaways: The violent merger left behind a single rejuvenated supergiant star nicknamed 'Bao'.
Provides rare observational data on how massive binary stars evolve and fuse.

stories.headline: Brown University study proves Einstein’s relativity blends triple-bond rules in heavy bismuth atoms
stories.summary: PROVIDENCE, Nov 22 — Chemists at Brown University published findings demonstrating that relativistic effects in heavy elements like bismuth cause normally distinct sigma and pi triple-bond orbitals to blend together.
takeaways: Shows textbook chemical bonding classifications break down at high atomic numbers.
Opens new design rules for heavy-element catalysts and quantum materials.

stories.headline: Kyushu University physicists propose ultra-precise atomic clock test for quantum superposition of time
stories.summary: FUKUOKA, Nov 22 — Physicists at Kyushu University outlined an experimental framework using next-generation optical atomic clocks to test whether time itself can exist in multiple quantum states simultaneously.
takeaways: Tests the intersection of general relativity's gravitational time dilation and quantum superposition.
Could verify whether a single clock can experience two flows of time at once.

stories.headline: Astronomers track Earth’s temporary 2-meter 'mini-moon' asteroid ahead of early December departure
stories.summary: PASADENA, Nov 22 — Astronomers completed final observational campaigns of Earth’s captured temporary second moon—a 2-meter asteroid trapped by planetary gravity since April—before it escapes back into solar orbit in December.
takeaways: Spectroscopic data confirmed the object is a natural silicate asteroid rather than space debris.
Will not return to Earth's vicinity for several decades.

stories.headline: Germany’s Isar Aerospace takes control of Spaceport Nova Scotia launch complex for North American flights
stories.summary: HALIFAX, Nov 22 — Commercial launch provider Isar Aerospace formally assumed operational control of its launch pad complex at Spaceport Nova Scotia in Canada, targeting orbital flights by 2028.
takeaways: Marks Isar Aerospace's first North American orbital launch site outside Europe.
Expands commercial polar and sun-synchronous satellite launch capacity.

stories.headline: Ukrainian General Staff reports heavy weekend drone attrition as Russian personnel losses pass 1.63 million
stories.summary: KYIV, Nov 22 — Intense UAV and artillery duels continued across eastern and southern Ukraine over the weekend, with Ukraine’s General Staff reporting cumulative Russian military casualties surpassing 1.63 million.
takeaways: Both sides deployed long-range strike drones targeting logistics and energy nodes.
Western allies accelerated deliveries of winter air-defense interceptors.

stories.headline: Brent crude oil drifts lower toward $90.85/bbl as global supply gains offset Middle East shipping friction
stories.summary: SINGAPORE, Nov 22 — Global crude oil benchmarks extended their November pullback, with Brent settling near $90.85 a barrel and WTI near $81.80 on rising non-OPEC supply and softer tech-led macro sentiment.
takeaways: Lower crude prices ease imported fuel subsidy pressures for Southeast Asian importers.
Traders remain watchful of U.S. naval blockade enforcement around Iranian ports.

stories.headline: NADMA and MetMalaysia maintain Northeast Monsoon flood watch across East Coast and Klang Valley
stories.summary: PUTRAJAYA, Nov 22 — The National Disaster Management Agency (NADMA) and MetMalaysia kept monsoon readiness protocols active across Perak, Pahang, Selangor, and Sabah as localized afternoon storms continued.
takeaways: Evacuee numbers declined in Selangor and Perak over the weekend while Negeri Sembilan centres closed.
River telemetry stations remain on yellow alert along major East Coast basins.

stories.headline: PAS rejects Amanah’s call to ditch Umno and join unity government, says vice-president Idris Ahmad
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 21 — PAS vice-president Idris Ahmad dismissed invitations from Amanah for PAS to abandon Umno and join the federal unity administration, stating PAS operates strictly on policy principles.
takeaways: Reaffirms PAS's commitment to Perikatan Nasional.
Responds to Amanah communications chief Khalid Samad's overture earlier in the week.

stories.headline: National cycling legend Datuk Azizulhasni Awang conferred Honorary PhD by UKM at 54th convocation
stories.summary: BANGI, Nov 21 — Track cycling icon Datuk Azizulhasni Awang was awarded an Honorary Doctor of Philosophy in Sports Development by Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia (UKM) at its 54th convocation ceremony.
takeaways: Honors 'The Pocket Rocketman' for two decades of Olympic and world championship excellence.
Recognizes his role in sports science advocacy and youth mentorship.

stories.headline: Two women killed in KM34 Federal Highway Mercedes crash; police hunt driver who fled scene
stories.summary: SHAH ALAM, Nov 21 — Two women died early Friday morning after being thrown from a Mercedes-Benz that skidded and slammed into an embankment at KM34 of the Federal Highway, prompting a police manhunt for the driver.
takeaways: The driver, believed to be a man in his 20s, fled the crash site before responders arrived.
Investigated under Section 41(1) of the Road Transport Act 1987.

stories.headline: Four underage teenagers arrested after high-speed North-South Expressway chase and patrol car ramming
stories.summary: SEREMBAN, Nov 21 — Police arrested four teenagers aged under 15 following a dangerous high-speed pursuit along the North-South Expressway (NSE) during which their vehicle rammed a police patrol car.
takeaways: No officers were seriously injured during the interception.
Police seized the vehicle and opened investigations into reckless driving and underage vehicle operation.

stories.headline: Flood conditions improve in Selangor and Perak with fewer evacuees as Negeri Sembilan fully recovers
stories.summary: IPOH, Nov 21 — Temporary flood relief centres (PPS) in Negeri Sembilan officially closed after floodwaters receded, while evacuee counts in Selangor and Perak declined steadily through Saturday.
takeaways: Civil Defence Force (APM) teams assisted residents with post-flood sanitation.
Drainage pumps remained deployed in low-lying Klang Valley districts.

stories.headline: Pakatan Harapan and Bersatu hold internal strategy reviews following Melaka polls ahead of GE16
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 21 — Political analysts and party leaders across Pakatan Harapan and Bersatu held post-mortem discussions examining voter turnout shifts from the Melaka polls and leadership succession plans ahead of GE16.
takeaways: Bersatu divisions debated long-term party direction following Tan Sri Muhyiddin Yassin's tenure.
PH component parties weighed seat negotiation formulas and youth outreach.

stories.headline: Negeri Sembilan PH demands BN and PN retract claims that state palace is under DAP influence
stories.summary: SEREMBAN, Nov 21 — Negeri Sembilan Pakatan Harapan leaders demanded an immediate retraction from BN and PN figures over allegations that the state palace was influenced by DAP during the Menteri Besar dispute.
takeaways: Defended the constitutional independence of the Negeri Sembilan Royal Institution.
Warned against dragging the palace into partisan state assembly politics.

stories.headline: Bukit Aman reveals syndicate used military aircraft to smuggle drugs into Sabah for regional export
stories.summary: KOTA KINABALU, Nov 21 — The Bukit Aman Narcotics Crime Investigation Department disclosed that a dismantled syndicate had used military transport flights to move illicit drugs into Sabah bound for Indonesia and the Philippines.
takeaways: Cross-border intelligence cooperation led to the seizure and syndicate arrests.
Tightened screening instituted across East Malaysian air logistics corridors.

stories.headline: Commonwealth weightlifting champion Mohd Hafizuddin Roslin stable after crash causes arm amputation
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 21 — National Commonwealth Games weightlifting gold medallist Mohd Hafizuddin Roslin was reported in stable condition at hospital after a severe motorcycle crash necessitated the amputation of his right arm.
takeaways: National Sports Council (MSN) pledged full medical, prosthetic, and welfare support.
Tributes poured in from the Malaysian sporting community.

stories.headline: Shah Alam High Court rules residents’ associations cannot force homeowners into compulsory membership
stories.summary: SHAH ALAM, Nov 21 — In a landmark housing decision, the Shah Alam High Court ruled that neighbourhood residents’ associations (RAs) have no legal right to compel non-consenting homeowners to become paying members.
takeaways: Clarifies the distinction between voluntary RAs and statutory strata management bodies (JMB/MC).
Protects constitutional freedom of association for individual landed property owners.

stories.headline: Trump says primary Iran goal is permanent nuclear and regional peace agreement rather than regime change
stories.summary: WASHINGTON, Nov 21 — U.S. President Donald Trump stated in a media interview that his administration’s top objective is reaching a permanent agreement to end Iran’s nuclear weapons ambitions rather than forcing regime change.
takeaways: Noted that internal leadership shifts have already reshaped Tehran's political calculus.
Maintains naval blockade pressure while signaling readiness for a verifiable nuclear deal.

stories.headline: UK and Ukraine expand joint production of middle- and deep-strike autonomous military drones
stories.summary: LONDON, Nov 21 — British and Ukrainian defense officials announced expanded co-production lines for middle- and deep-strike long-range UAVs to sustain Kyiv’s strategic deterrence capacity.
takeaways: Pairs UK defense financing and avionics with Ukrainian battlefield UAV engineering.
Focuses on electronic-warfare-resistant navigation systems.

stories.headline: U.S. authorities investigate suspected security breach targeting FBI’s National Crime Information Center
stories.summary: WASHINGTON, Nov 21 — Federal cybersecurity teams launched an investigation into a suspected breach involving the FBI’s National Crime Information Center (NCIC) database used by police agencies nationwide.
takeaways: NCIC handles real-time criminal warrant, stolen property, and background check queries.
Agencies reviewed access logs and isolated potentially affected third-party vendor portals.

stories.headline: UN autonomous weapons treaty talks in Geneva collapse without negotiating mandate
stories.summary: GENEVA, Nov 21 — Week-long diplomatic talks at the UN Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons (CCW) in Geneva ended in deadlock, failing to establish a mandate for a binding treaty on lethal autonomous weapons.
takeaways: Procedural objections by Russia and caution from major military powers blocked consensus.
Civil society coalitions urged taking autonomous weapons governance to the UN General Assembly.

stories.headline: South Korea’s Education Minister resigns after emergency cabinet meeting over AI exam-cheating scandal
stories.summary: SEOUL, Nov 21 — South Korea’s education minister stepped down following an emergency cabinet session prompted by a nationwide AI cheating scandal across university and high-school entrance assessments.
takeaways: Exposed gaps in exam proctoring against covert wearable and smartphone AI tools.
Prompted an immediate audit of national academic testing protocols.

stories.headline: China’s AI stock trade sheds $1.7 trillion since June as valuation bubble unravels
stories.summary: SHANGHAI / HONG KONG, Nov 21 — Tech-heavy equity indexes across China have lost $1.7 trillion in combined market capitalization since their June highs as frothy AI valuations collided with U.S. chip and cloud restrictions.
takeaways: Tighter U.S. BIS remote-compute rules intensified selling in domestic Chinese cloud and chip names.
Institutional funds rotated into defensive dividend and state-backed utility stocks.

stories.headline: U.S. Senate passes first federal prediction markets bill establishing regulatory oversight
stories.summary: WASHINGTON, Nov 21 — The U.S. Senate passed its first comprehensive federal legislation governing event and prediction markets, defining boundaries between regulated financial hedging contracts and prohibited gambling.
takeaways: Establishes CFTC oversight rules for event-contract liquidity providers and retail platforms.
Follows rapid growth in institutional and retail political and macro prediction trading.

stories.headline: University of Plymouth AI tool detects bladder cancer up to 5 years early across 70,000-patient study
stories.summary: PLYMOUTH, Nov 21 — Scientists at the University of Plymouth developed an AI screening algorithm capable of flagging subtle clinical precursors of bladder cancer up to five years before diagnosis with 85% sensitivity.
takeaways: Validated on longitudinal health records from nearly 70,000 patients.
Could reduce invasive cystoscopy procedures and improve early-stage survival rates.

stories.headline: SpaceX Dragon CRS-35 splashes down off California returning 3D-bioprinted blood vessels from ISS
stories.summary: LOS ANGELES, Nov 21 — NASA’s 35th SpaceX commercial resupply mission concluded with a Pacific Ocean splashdown returning 3D-bioprinted vascular constructs, frozen tumor organoids, and antibiotic-resistance samples.
takeaways: 3D-bioprinted blood vessels studied accelerated vascular aging in microgravity.
Tumor organoids will guide personalized oncology drug screening on Earth.

stories.headline: HKUST biologists discover gutless deep-sea mollusk Chaetoderma shenloong powered by bacterial organelle
stories.summary: HONG KONG, Nov 21 — Researchers at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) described Chaetoderma shenloong, a deep-sea mollusk living in oxygen-depleted waters without a digestive system.
takeaways: Survives via a newly identified specialized organelle called the 'dracosphera' housing symbiotic bacteria.
Sheds new light on extreme metabolic adaptation in abyssal marine trenches.

stories.headline: Global digital infrastructure outages prompt calls for mandatory cloud redundancy audits
stories.summary: LONDON, Nov 21 — Following a week of cascading banking, aviation, and third-party CDN disruptions, technology policy institutes called for mandatory multi-cloud failover testing across critical infrastructure.
takeaways: Analysts noted single-vendor software updates repeatedly triggered cross-sector outages.
Financial regulators in the US, UK, and Asia are reviewing operational resilience rules.

stories.headline: Global investors flood into U.S. Treasury bonds as equity volatility drives flight to safety
stories.summary: NEW YORK, Nov 21 — Fixed-income markets rallied at the end of the week as institutional managers shifted capital out of high-multiple tech stocks into 2-year and 10-year U.S. Treasury notes.
takeaways: Treasury yields dipped across the curve as bond prices climbed.
Reflects hedging against a potential Q4 global growth slowdown.

stories.headline: Police shoot dead armed robbery suspect in Ipoh shootout and arrest Chow Kit stolen-taxi predator
stories.summary: IPOH / KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 21 — Perak police shot dead an armed suspect with multiple prior criminal records during an early-morning shootout in Ipoh, while KL police arrested a man using a stolen taxi to rob elderly victims in Chow Kit.
takeaways: Firearms and stolen valuables were recovered from the scene in Ipoh.
KL police urged elderly pedestrians to remain vigilant around unlicensed taxis.

stories.headline: Fahmi Fadzil: MCMC completing technical trials for National Disaster Warning System mobile broadcast alerts
stories.summary: PUTRAJAYA, Nov 21 — Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil announced that the Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission (MCMC) is finalizing technical cell-broadcast tests for the National Disaster Warning System.
takeaways: Will push instant flood, earthquake, and severe weather alerts directly to smartphones without requiring an app.
Rollout coordinated between MCMC, NADMA, and all domestic mobile telcos.

stories.headline: Anwar secures RM9.2b in indicative Chinese high-tech & green energy investments at APEC Shenzhen
stories.summary: SHENZHEN, Nov 20 — Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim concluded Malaysia’s working visit to the 33rd APEC Summit in Shenzhen with RM9.2 billion in indicative investment proposals from Chinese high-tech and new energy companies.
takeaways: Projects target industrial parks across Kedah, Penang, Selangor, and Pahang.
Covers EV components, solar storage, and advanced semiconductor packaging.

stories.headline: Lim Guan Eng urges Putrajaya to press U.S. over remote-access AI chip licensing rules on Malaysia
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 20 — DAP adviser Lim Guan Eng urged PM Anwar Ibrahim to challenge Washington’s new BIS licensing mandate for advanced AI chips shipped to Malaysia, calling it unfair 'collective punishment'.
takeaways: Malaysia was grouped with Thailand, Indonesia, Singapore, and Brazil under new diversion-risk rules.
Local data-centre operators seek fast-track validated end-user exemptions.

stories.headline: Malaysia welcomes ICJ landmark verdict holding Myanmar responsible for Rohingya genocide
stories.summary: PUTRAJAYA, Nov 20 — Wisma Putra stated that Malaysia respects and welcomes the International Court of Justice (ICJ) ruling formally holding Myanmar responsible for genocide against the Rohingya under the 1948 Convention.
takeaways: Urged ASEAN and the UN Security Council to enforce accountability and safe humanitarian conditions.
Malaysia currently hosts over 100,000 registered Rohingya refugees.

stories.headline: Declassified Pardons Board papers show cabinet interactions over house arrest addendum, says Lim Guan Eng
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 20 — Following the declassification of Federal Territories Pardons Board documents for court proceedings, political leaders weighed in on recorded ministerial objections including from Youth and Sports Minister Hannah Yeoh.
takeaways: Documents were tabled to assist the court in the Malaysian Bar's judicial review application.
Debate continued across coalition lines over transparency and constitutional procedure.

stories.headline: Malaysia’s October headline inflation edges up modestly to 1.9% amid stable domestic food and fuel prices
stories.summary: PUTRAJAYA, Nov 20 — The Department of Statistics Malaysia (DOSM) reported that Malaysia’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 1.9% year-on-year in October 2026, remaining benign relative to regional peers.
takeaways: Targeted diesel and fuel subsidy rationalization kept transport inflation contained.
Supports Bank Negara Malaysia's steady Overnight Policy Rate (OPR) stance.

stories.headline: MetMalaysia issues severe thunderstorm warnings across Klang Valley, Putrajaya, Johor, Sabah and Labuan
stories.summary: PETALING JAYA, Nov 20 — MetMalaysia issued severe thunderstorm alerts forecasting heavy rain, lightning, and gusty winds across Kuala Lumpur, Selangor, Putrajaya, Johor, Sabah, and Labuan.
takeaways: Advisories triggered evening flash-flood monitoring across urban highways.
Residents in low-lying river basins advised to track public warning sirens.

stories.headline: Penang expands state funding for early STEM and AI talent pipeline to support semiconductor sector
stories.summary: GEORGE TOWN, Nov 20 — The Penang state government announced new funding allocations for school and polytechnic AI and semiconductor engineering programs to meet surging talent demand from Bayan Lepas and Batu Kawan fabs.
takeaways: Partners with multinational E&E employers to modernize IC design curricula.
Aims to reduce Malaysia's engineering talent deficit over the next five years.

stories.headline: Trump, Xi, and Putin conclude Shenzhen trilateral summit with declaration on nuclear risk & UN reform
stories.summary: SHENZHEN, Nov 20 — The U.S., Chinese, and Russian presidents wrapped up their three-way summit in Shenzhen by issuing a joint declaration on nuclear risk reduction, energy supply stability, and UN reform.
takeaways: Communiqué notably omitted direct commitments on ending the war in Ukraine.
Marked the most closely watched diplomatic meeting of the 2026 APEC week.

stories.headline: Xi Jinping holds bilateral summits in Shenzhen with Australia’s Albanese and Indonesia’s Prabowo Subianto
stories.summary: SHENZHEN, Nov 20 — On the sidelines of APEC, Chinese President Xi Jinping met Australian PM Anthony Albanese to mark steps toward 55 years of diplomatic ties and held talks with Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto.
takeaways: Discussions covered critical minerals, green energy trade, and South China Sea maritime stability.
Reinforced intra-Asia trade ties amid U.S. tariff uncertainty.

stories.headline: International Court of Justice formally holds Myanmar responsible for Rohingya genocide in historic first
stories.summary: THE HAGUE, Nov 20 — In a landmark judgment, the UN’s International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar violated the 1948 Genocide Convention against the Rohingya minority—the first time the court has held a state directly responsible for genocide.
takeaways: Case originally brought by The Gambia with backing from the OIC including Malaysia.
Triggers global legal pressure for reparations and international sanctions.

stories.headline: Downing Street announces post-Brexit 'reset' deal agreed with the European Union
stories.summary: LONDON, Nov 20 — The UK government announced it has reached agreement with Brussels on a post-Brexit 'reset' package covering veterinary checks, youth mobility quotas, and security cooperation.
takeaways: Follow-on technical talks will continue on fisheries and regulatory alignment.
Aims to reduce cross-Channel trade friction for British exporters.

stories.headline: African ministers slam wealthy nations at COP31 Antalya over climate finance and fossil-fuel language
stories.summary: ANTALYA, Nov 20 — Going into the final scheduled day of COP31 in Turkey, African environment ministers and small-island delegates criticized draft texts for watering down climate adaptation finance commitments.
takeaways: Accused developed polluting nations of shifting public grant obligations onto private loans.
Set the stage for weekend overtime negotiations in Antalya.

stories.headline: Tokyo’s Nikkei (-5.1%) and Seoul’s Kospi (-5.2%) plunge as global AI equity rout accelerates
stories.summary: TOKYO / SEOUL, Nov 20 — Asian equity benchmarks suffered steep losses on Friday as Wall Street’s post-Anthropic IPO rotation triggered a 5.1% drop in Japan’s Nikkei 225 and a 5.2% slide in South Korea’s Kospi.
takeaways: Chipmakers and data-centre hardware suppliers led declines across Tokyo, Seoul, and Taipei.
Investors questioned the near-term return on multi-trillion-dollar AI infrastructure budgets.

stories.headline: Citigroup warns S&P 500 'Generals' indicator is near flashing red as 4 of top 7 megacaps test 200-DMA
stories.summary: NEW YORK, Nov 20 — Citigroup equity strategists issued a note warning that their 'Generals' risk indicator is close to triggering as Nvidia, Alphabet, Meta Platforms, and Broadcom test their 200-day moving averages.
takeaways: Signal triggers when four of the seven largest S&P 500 companies stay below their 200-DMA for five days.
Historically preceded broader market leadership rotations in 2000 and late 2021.

stories.headline: California regulators probe Nvidia chip export compliance pathways as European chipmaker ASML slides
stories.summary: SACRAMENTO / AMSTERDAM, Nov 20 — California state authorities opened an inquiry into semiconductor export compliance pathways involving Nvidia, while European lithography giant ASML dropped in sympathy with global chip stocks.
takeaways: Follows federal scrutiny over whether restricted AI chips reached Chinese entities via intermediaries.
Added regulatory headwinds to semiconductor equipment valuations.

stories.headline: Bundesbank President Joachim Nagel signals potential ECB rate-hike risks if inflation remains sticky
stories.summary: FRANKFURT, Nov 20 — Bundesbank President Joachim Nagel warned that the European Central Bank cannot rule out further interest rate hikes if wage growth, energy costs, and AI capex demand keep inflation elevated.
takeaways: Pushed Eurozone sovereign bond yields higher across the curve.
Echoed hawkish warnings issued by the IMF and Reserve Bank of Australia earlier in the week.

stories.headline: Iceland’s Blue Lagoon Corp officially debuts shares on the Nasdaq Iceland Main Market
stories.summary: REYKJAVIK, Nov 20 — Geothermal spa and hospitality operator Blue Lagoon Corp completed its public listing on the Nasdaq Iceland Main Market following resilient post-volcanic tourism recovery.
takeaways: One of the most prominent Nordic consumer and tourism listings of Q4 2026.
Proceeds will fund sustainable geothermal resort upgrades.

stories.headline: Beazley Security threat report reveals attackers routinely bypass MFA via session tokens and infostealers
stories.summary: LONDON, Nov 20 — Beazley Security’s November threat intelligence report warned that cybercriminals are bypassing Multi-Factor Authentication without breaking it by stealing active session cookies and abusing device codes.
takeaways: Standard MFA compliance checklists fail to stop post-authentication session token hijacking.
Recommends phishing-resistant FIDO2 passkeys and continuous session risk binding.

stories.headline: Starling Bank founder Anne Boden unveils agentic AI banking venture 'Lockwood'; Payhawk hits $2B valuation
stories.summary: LONDON, Nov 20 — Starling Bank founder Anne Boden pulled back the curtain on Lockwood, a new banking venture built around agentic AI, while corporate spend fintech Payhawk raised $280M Series C at a $2B valuation.
takeaways: Payhawk's $280M round was led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives.
Lockwood aims to replace static mobile banking menus with autonomous financial agents.

stories.headline: South Korea’s KT and LG Electronics demonstrate Quantum Secure Direct Communication (QSDC)
stories.summary: SEOUL, Nov 20 — Telecom operator KT and LG Electronics completed a successful joint demonstration of Quantum Secure Direct Communication (QSDC), transmitting confidential messages directly over quantum states.
takeaways: Eliminates separate key-exchange channels by detecting eavesdropping directly in the quantum transmission.
Advances South Korea's national quantum cryptography backbone.

stories.headline: Analog AI chipmaker TetraMem honored on Clarivate Highly Cited list; Australia injects $81M into AI CRC-P grants
stories.summary: SAN JOSE / CANBERRA, Nov 20 — Five founding researchers at RRAM analog in-memory computing pioneer TetraMem were named to Clarivate’s 2026 Highly Cited list, while Australia rolled out $81M in Round 19 CRC-P AI innovation grants.
takeaways: TetraMem's RRAM chips target drastic power reductions for edge and data-centre AI inference.
Australian grants fund breath-based diabetes sensors, medical AI, and satellite weather radar.

stories.headline: Max Planck astronomers trace gas clouds feeding Milky Way’s supermassive black hole to colliding-wind stars
stories.summary: MUNICH, Nov 20 — Astronomers at the Max Planck Institute for Extraterrestrial Physics discovered that mysterious gas clumps near Sagittarius A* originate from colliding stellar winds of a massive binary star system.
takeaways: High-velocity wind collisions compress gas into dense clouds that spiral toward the black hole.
Solves a long-standing puzzle over how Sagittarius A* acquires fresh fuel.

stories.headline: University of Wollongong geologists solve Earth’s 'missing billion years' via deep mantle convection waves
stories.summary: WOLLONGONG, Nov 20 — Geologists at the University of Wollongong modeled how slow deep-mantle currents raised and lowered continents over eons, eroding more than a billion years of missing rock strata ('the Great Unconformity').
takeaways: In paleobotany, 390-million-year-old Calamophyton fossils in England also pinpointed the rise of Earth's earliest forests.
Provides a unified tectonic model for continental erosion gaps worldwide.

stories.headline: Duke liver-targeted RNA therapy prevents rare brain injury; magnetic nanoparticles achieve implant-free brain stimulation
stories.summary: DURHAM, Nov 20 — Duke University School of Medicine used a liver-targeted siRNA therapy to halt brain injury in mouse models of Glutaric Aciduria Type I (GA1), while a separate team achieved non-invasive deep brain stimulation with magnetic nanoparticles.
takeaways: Targeting lysine metabolism in the liver stopped neurotoxic byproducts from damaging the brain.
Magnetic nanoparticle stimulation improved Parkinson's-like movement deficits in mice without implanted wires.

stories.headline: Negeri Sembilan Palace directs Ismail Lasim to prove majority support in state assembly
stories.summary: SEREMBAN, Nov 19 — The Negeri Sembilan Palace issued an official communiqué requiring Datuk Ismail Lasim to formally prove he commands majority support in the state assembly and submit a list of executive councillors.
takeaways: Followed Ismail's denial that he had resigned as Menteri Besar, contradicting an earlier BN statement.
Emphasized adherence to the Negeri Sembilan State Constitution.

stories.headline: Forensics analyst tells Sessions Court ex-Petronas manager’s confidential email to Petros bounced on file-size limit
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 19 — A digital forensics specialist testified in the Sessions Court that a former Petronas manager’s 2024 attempt to email a confidential document to Sarawak’s Petros failed because the attachment exceeded server size limits.
takeaways: Server logs verified the outbound message was rejected before reaching the recipient.
Case remains closely watched amid federal-state oil and gas regulatory discussions.

stories.headline: PM Anwar champions Global South cooperation and ethical digital governance in APEC national statement
stories.summary: SHENZHEN, Nov 19 — Delivering Malaysia’s national statement at the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting in Shenzhen, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim called for equitable AI governance, green transition funding, and Global South inclusion.
takeaways: Highlighted ASEAN's Digital Economy Framework Agreement as a model for cross-border trade.
Urged major powers to avoid fragmenting global semiconductor supply chains.

stories.headline: Anwar credits proactive Madani government fiscal and fuel measures for sustaining 5.6% nine-month GDP growth
stories.summary: PUTRAJAYA, Nov 19 — Prime Minister and Finance Minister Anwar Ibrahim stated that Malaysia’s 5.6% growth across the first nine months of 2026 reflects disciplined subsidy targeting and export competitiveness despite Middle East volatility.
takeaways: Record E&E export receipts and domestic services growth anchored Q3 performance.
Pledged continued fiscal consolidation alongside targeted cost-of-living support.

stories.headline: Anthony Loke leaves coalition alignment and cabinet review discussions to direct talks with PM Anwar
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 19 — Transport Minister and DAP secretary-general Anthony Loke stated that any coalition adjustments or state-level political realignments will be discussed directly with Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim.
takeaways: Urged party members to stay focused on governance delivery rather than public speculation.
Reaffirmed DAP's backing for the federal unity government's full-term stability.

stories.headline: Trump, Xi, and Putin open historic three-way strategic stability and nuclear talks in Shenzhen
stories.summary: SHENZHEN, Nov 19 — U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin convened on the sidelines of APEC in Shenzhen for unprecedented trilateral strategic stability discussions.
takeaways: Centered on nuclear risk reduction, energy corridors, and strategic arms dialogue.
Held under intense global media and diplomatic scrutiny.

stories.headline: Anthropic debuts on Nasdaq under ticker 'ANT' at $83/share, raising record $81.3 billion
stories.summary: NEW YORK, Nov 19 — AI developer Anthropic made its blockbuster public debut on the Nasdaq under ticker 'ANT', raising $81.3 billion and surging on day one to become the highest-valued public benefit corporation in U.S. history.
takeaways: Briefly touched a $2 trillion intraday valuation before closing day one near $1.27 trillion.
Marked a watershed capital-markets test for frontier AI commercialization.

stories.headline: IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva warns surging AI infrastructure demand is fueling global inflation and rate risks
stories.summary: SHENZHEN, Nov 19 — Speaking at APEC, IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva warned that massive global demand for AI chips, data centres, and electricity is driving up prices and may force central banks to hike interest rates.
takeaways: Combined with Middle East energy shipping costs, AI capex inflation complicates central bank easing.
Triggered immediate repricing across global sovereign bond markets.

stories.headline: Atomico’s State of European Tech report at Slush Helsinki projects European VC funding jumping 62% to $81B
stories.summary: HELSINKI, Nov 19 — Launched at the Slush conference in Helsinki, Atomico’s 2026 report showed European tech investment rising 62% year-on-year to $81 billion, propelled by $1B+ AI and defense megarounds.
takeaways: Warned that late-stage European university spin-outs still rely heavily on U.S. capital and acquirers.
AI compute and defense tech accounted for the lion's share of 2026 European venture growth.

stories.headline: Real-world LEADER study at CTAD Boston shows LEQEMBI cuts Alzheimer’s progression by 76% across 560 patients
stories.summary: BOSTON, Nov 19 — At the 19th Clinical Trials on Alzheimer’s Disease (CTAD) conference, Eisai and Biogen presented LEADER study data showing LEQEMBI slowed progression to moderate or severe Alzheimer’s dementia by 76%.
takeaways: Compared 560 real-world treated patients against a matched natural-history cohort.
Reinforces clinical benefits of early amyloid-plaque clearance.

stories.headline: Global AI-assisted drug discovery software market projected to reach $570 million in 2026
stories.summary: BOSTON, Nov 19 — New biopharma market research released mid-week projected the global AI-assisted drug discovery software sector reaching nearly $570 million in 2026 as generative molecular simulation enters mainstream R&D.
takeaways: Major pharmaceutical firms are integrating generative protein and small-molecule models into preclinical pipelines.
Reduces early target-identification timelines from years to months.

stories.headline: Climate scientists led by Johan Rockström warn against political and administrative delays to UN IPCC reports
stories.summary: POTSDAM, Nov 19 — Leading climate scientists including Potsdam Institute director Johan Rockström publicly criticized delays slowing down upcoming UN Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) assessments.
takeaways: Warned that stalling objective scientific assessments undermines COP31 and 2030 emissions targets.
Called for protected funding and timely publication schedules.

stories.headline: ISS Expedition 75 crew conducts microgravity human physiology tests ahead of cargo resupply rotations
stories.summary: HOUSTON, Nov 19 — Astronauts aboard the International Space Station conducted Standard Measures human health and immune physiology experiments on Nov 19 while preparing for SpaceX Dragon cargo departure.
takeaways: Tracked cardiovascular and cellular adaptation to long-duration microgravity.
Packed biological samples into cold stowage freezers for return to Earth.

stories.headline: European Commission research chiefs and MEPs debate structure and funding safeguards for upcoming FP10 programme
stories.summary: BRUSSELS, Nov 19 — European Parliament research leaders and Commission officials held intensive hearings on the structure of the upcoming 10th Framework Programme (FP10) for research and innovation.
takeaways: University associations warned againstring-fencing shortfalls if associated-country contributions aren't balanced.
Debated balancing fundamental ERC grants against industrial competitiveness funds.

stories.headline: White House and FAA complete post-mortem on software bugs that triggered brief nationwide U.S. flight ground stop
stories.summary: WASHINGTON, Nov 19 — Federal aviation and cybersecurity agencies confirmed that a brief nationwide FAA ground stop and banking disruptions earlier in the week resulted from cascading software update bugs rather than cyberattacks.
takeaways: Prompted new federal procurement rules requiring staged rollouts for mission-critical aviation software.
Coincided with Microsoft's disclosure of a July cloud data-centre bug.

stories.headline: Vietnam’s Ministry of Finance rolls out 'Twin Transition' digital and green readiness framework for enterprises
stories.summary: HANOI, Nov 19 — Vietnam introduced a national dual-assessment framework evaluating domestic corporations on both digital transformation maturity and green transition compliance to boost ASEAN export competitiveness.
takeaways: Helps suppliers meet EU carbon-border (CBAM) and multinational supply-chain standards.
Part of a broader ASEAN push into high-value green manufacturing.

stories.headline: S&P 500 logs longest losing streak since 2024 as post-IPO tech profit-taking weighs on Wall Street
stories.summary: NEW YORK, Nov 19 — U.S. equities closed lower on Thursday, extending the S&P 500’s consecutive session losing streak to its longest run since 2024 as institutional traders rotated out of megacap semiconductor shares.
takeaways: Anthropic's massive $81.3B IPO absorbed institutional tech liquidity.
Higher Treasury yields added valuation pressure on high-multiple software names.

stories.headline: U.S. Fifth Fleet maintains three-carrier maritime blockade off Iranian ports as Hormuz transit tensions persist
stories.summary: MANAMA, Nov 19 — The USS Theodore Roosevelt, USS George H.W. Bush, and USS George Washington strike groups continued coordinated patrol operations enforcing maritime restrictions on Iranian crude exports.
takeaways: Regional commercial shipping insurers maintained elevated war-risk premiums across the Persian Gulf.
Diplomatic backchannels continued via Gulf intermediaries.

stories.headline: European leaders and U.S. envoys prepare Berlin 'Coalition of the Willing' security talks with Kyiv
stories.summary: BERLIN, Nov 19 — Following online consultations between President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, European capitals prepared follow-up Berlin security guarantee talks.
takeaways: European leaders insisted on formal inclusion in any ceasefire or territorial framework.
Focused on winter air-defense grids and long-term defense industrial backing.

stories.headline: Bursa Malaysia data-centre and utility counters trade cautiously amid U.S. BIS remote-compute licensing review
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 19 — Technology and power-infrastructure counters on Bursa Malaysia saw cautious institutional trading as analysts assessed compliance timelines for new U.S. AI chip export licenses.
takeaways: Long-term Johor and Cyberjaya hyperscale build-outs remain anchored by sovereign cloud commitments.
Analysts expect Tier-1 U.S. cloud providers in Malaysia to receive validated end-user clearances.

stories.headline: Federal government reaffirms commitment to Sabah and Sarawak subsea digital and power grid connectivity
stories.summary: KOTA KINABALU, Nov 19 — Following approval of TM Tech’s RM2.7 billion submarine cable project, federal ministries reiterated plans to accelerate redundant fibre and renewable energy links across East Malaysia.
takeaways: Supports rising digital economy and data-centre demand in Kota Kinabalu and Kuching.
Complements the ongoing Sarawak-Sabah-Brunei power grid interconnection.

stories.headline: NASA JPL engineers work to restore Voyager 1 science telemetry after confirming one light-day carrier milestone
stories.summary: PASADENA, Nov 19 — NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory engineers analyzed a temporary science telemetry pause on Voyager 1 while confirming the probe’s continuous radio carrier signal remains stable at one light-day distance.
takeaways: Round-trip radio communication with Voyager 1 now takes a full 48 hours.
Spacecraft power and attitude-control systems remain nominal in interstellar space.

stories.headline: ASEAN energy ministers begin technical feasibility review of Japan’s regional emergency oil-stockpiling proposal
stories.summary: MANILA, Nov 19 — Following Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi’s proposal in Manila, ASEAN energy officials initiated feasibility studies on utilizing Japan’s spare crude storage capacity as a regional emergency buffer.
takeaways: Designed to cushion Southeast Asian economies against Strait of Hormuz supply disruptions.
Coordinates emergency release triggers across ASEAN+3 members.

stories.headline: DBKL deploys rapid-response flood pumping teams across 25 Kuala Lumpur hotspot zones amid monsoon storms
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 19 — Kuala Lumpur City Hall (DBKL) stationed high-capacity mobile water pumps and 24-hour emergency squads across 25 flash-flood hotspots following MetMalaysia’s severe storm warnings.
takeaways: SMART Tunnel stormwater diversion protocols remain on standby during peak evening downpours.
Motorists can track live road water-level alerts via DBKL traffic channels.

stories.headline: Bank Negara Malaysia: Economy grew 5.5% in Q3 2026, beating 5.3% advance estimate on AI tech export surge
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 18 — Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) officially announced that Malaysia’s economy expanded by 5.5% in the third quarter of 2026, surpassing the 5.3% advance estimate and bringing nine-month growth to 5.6%.
takeaways: Driven by resilient household spending, strong investment realization, and booming E&E semiconductor exports.
Demonstrates Malaysia's leverage to the global AI hardware and data-centre supply chain.

stories.headline: Ringgit trades firmer against major currencies following upbeat 5.5% Q3 GDP expansion
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 18 — The Malaysian ringgit strengthened against major currency peers on Wednesday after Bank Negara’s stronger-than-expected 5.5% Q3 GDP print reinforced confidence in domestic fundamentals.
takeaways: Positive growth differential and steady export conversions supported local currency demand.
Traders balanced domestic macro strength against U.S. Federal Reserve rate expectations.

stories.headline: Sri Maha Mariamman Temple management dismisses social media claims over PM Anwar and French President Macron’s visit
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 18 — The management of the historic Sri Maha Mariamman Temple in Kuala Lumpur dismissed viral social media claims alleging religious disrespect during an unscheduled visit by PM Anwar Ibrahim and French President Emmanuel Macron.
takeaways: Clarified that the Nov 17 heritage visit was conducted respectfully with full temple protocol.
Urged netizens not to politicize diplomatic cultural visits.

stories.headline: World leaders convene in Shenzhen for 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting amid U.S.–China tech tensions
stories.summary: SHENZHEN, Nov 18 — Leaders from across the Asia-Pacific gathered in Shenzhen, China for the 33rd APEC Summit, holding high-stakes bilateral talks on trade, supply chains, and digital governance.
takeaways: U.S. President Donald Trump arrived from Manila for summit sessions alongside Chinese President Xi Jinping.
Discussions included Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi, Canadian PM Mark Carney, and Malaysian PM Anwar Ibrahim.

stories.headline: Putin pitches Russia as equal partner in multipolar world order during APEC Shenzhen sessions
stories.summary: SHENZHEN, Nov 18 — Russian President Vladimir Putin used his APEC summit appearances in Shenzhen to advocate a multipolar financial and security order ahead of Thursday’s trilateral meeting with Trump and Xi.
takeaways: Focused on non-Western trade settlement corridors and Arctic-Pacific energy routes.
Diplomatic observers closely tracked parallel discussions on the war in Ukraine.

stories.headline: U.S. Embassy in Kuwait issues heightened security alert for Americans across Middle East over Houthi threats
stories.summary: KUWAIT CITY, Nov 18 — The U.S. Embassy in Kuwait issued an elevated regional security alert for American citizens across the Middle East, citing rising drone and missile threats from Iranian-backed Houthis.
takeaways: Warned of potential spillover risks to commercial aviation and maritime transit.
Coincided with the three-carrier U.S. naval blockade operating near Iranian waters.

stories.headline: Bipartisan U.S. senators grill White House AI czar Jay Clayton over cascading software bugs and FAA groundings
stories.summary: WASHINGTON, Nov 18 — U.S. senators pressed White House AI and national security czar Jay Clayton to address deep software supply-chain fragility after cascading update bugs disrupted banks and briefly grounded U.S. flights.
takeaways: Officials confirmed the disruptions were caused by flawed software updates rather than hostile cyberattacks.
Senators warned that AI tools are accelerating vulnerability discovery faster than patching cycles.

stories.headline: Microsoft Ignite 2026 launches general availability for Agent 365, Azure Catalyst, and Entra Agent Identity
stories.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, Nov 18 — At Microsoft Ignite 2026, the company announced general availability for its enterprise agentic AI suite including Agent 365, Azure Catalyst, and Entra Agent Identity.
takeaways: Provides zero-trust identity, permissions, and audit trails for autonomous enterprise AI agents.
Follows Microsoft's post-mortem on an undetected July data-centre software bug.

stories.headline: China Telecom’s TeleChat lab unveils 'Xing4', a 285B agentic MoE model trained entirely on Huawei Ascend NPUs
stories.summary: BEIJING, Nov 18 — China Telecom’s TeleChat lab published Xing4, a 285-billion-parameter agentic Mixture-of-Experts model trained purely on Huawei Ascend NPUs and the MindSpore framework without Nvidia GPUs or CUDA.
takeaways: Marks a major milestone in China's domestic non-CUDA AI training software stack.
Demonstrates high-efficiency agentic tool-use trained on indigenous silicon.

stories.headline: Nvidia posts record $115.8B Q3 revenue (+103% YoY) under interim CEO Colette Kress but halts H200 sales to China
stories.summary: SANTA CLARA, Nov 18 — Nvidia beat Wall Street forecasts with $115.8 billion in Q3 FY27 revenue (up 103% YoY) in its first earnings report after Jensen Huang’s exit, while announcing a halt to H200 chip sales to China.
takeaways: Exceeded the $109B consensus estimate, though export compliance costs and leadership questions weighed on sentiment.
Interim CEO & CFO Colette Kress confirmed Nvidia is rolling back prior China H200 distribution plans.

stories.headline: Pfizer signs exclusive licensing agreement with Starna Therapeutics for autoimmune and in vivo CAR-T programs
stories.summary: NEW YORK, Nov 18 — Pharmaceutical giant Pfizer announced an exclusive licensing and research collaboration with Starna Therapeutics targeting novel RNA delivery and in vivo CAR-T therapies for autoimmune diseases.
takeaways: Expands Pfizer's immunology pipeline beyond oncology into next-generation cell therapy.
Includes upfront payments and development milestones.

stories.headline: Five major Nordic universities launch Nordic Deep Tech Alliance to scale academic startups into manufacturing
stories.summary: HELSINKI / STOCKHOLM, Nov 18 — Five leading technical universities across Finland, Sweden, Denmark, and Norway formed the Nordic Deep Tech Alliance at Slush to bridge academic spin-outs into commercial scale-ups.
takeaways: Addresses the late-stage European funding gap identified in Atomico's 2026 report.
Harmonizes IP licensing and cross-Nordic venture co-investment.

stories.headline: NASA’s Voyager 1 officially crosses one light-day distance from Earth (~16.094 billion miles) at 5:16 a.m. EST
stories.summary: PASADENA, Nov 18 — Nearly 50 years after its September 1977 launch, NASA’s Voyager 1 officially crossed one light-day from Earth (25.902 billion km / 16.094 billion miles), confirmed via its continuous carrier signal.
takeaways: Precision timing partner Frequency Electronics (FEIM) and NASA JPL celebrated the 24-light-hour milestone.
Twin spacecraft Voyager 2 is projected to reach one light-day in November 2035.

stories.headline: NASA completes full-duration hot-fire test of Artemis RS-25 Engine No. 10001 at Stennis Space Center
stories.summary: STENNIS, Nov 18 — NASA engineers successfully conducted a hot-fire test of an upgraded RS-25 Space Launch System engine (Engine No. 10001) on the Fred Haise Test Stand in Mississippi for future crewed Artemis missions.
takeaways: Validated new 3D-printed pogo accumulator and nozzle components under full thrust.
Supports deep-space lunar missions beginning with Artemis V.

stories.headline: Korea Exchange delays Seoul stock and FX market opening by one hour for national Suneung college entrance exams
stories.summary: SEOUL, Nov 18 — South Korea’s financial markets opened one hour later than usual as part of nationwide traffic and noise-control measures supporting students sitting the high-stakes Suneung university entrance examination.
takeaways: Annual national mobilization also pauses aircraft takeoffs and landings during the English listening test.
Normal trading hours resume following the two-day exam window.

stories.headline: Slush Helsinki data shows $1B+ AI and defense megarounds driving 62% surge in European venture funding
stories.summary: HELSINKI, Nov 18 — Detailed Dealroom and Atomico data released at Slush showed European venture capital hitting $81 billion in 2026, though authors warned U.S. acquirers still absorb many top university spin-outs.
takeaways: Urged European pension funds to allocate more growth capital to domestic deep-tech scale-ups.
Highlighted sovereign AI compute clusters in France, Germany, and the Nordics.

stories.headline: Canadian PM Mark Carney and Xi Jinping finalize tariff cuts on Canadian seafood and pork in Shenzhen
stories.summary: SHENZHEN, Nov 18 — Following bilateral talks ahead of APEC in Shenzhen, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and Chinese President Xi Jinping enacted tariff reductions on Canadian seafood, pork, and agricultural exports.
takeaways: De-escalates bilateral trade friction between Ottawa and Beijing.
Opens expanded cold-chain export quotas for Canadian producers.

stories.headline: Global enterprises complete emergencyCSP hardening after OPTIMJACK supply-chain attack on Optimizely CDN
stories.summary: LONDON, Nov 18 — Security teams across 178+ global organizations completed forensic audits and Content Security Policy (CSP) updates following Monday’s OPTIMJACK malicious JavaScript injection on Optimizely Web.
takeaways: Researchers confirmed strict script-src and connect-src CSP rules blocked data exfiltration on hardened sites.
Prompted industry-wide review of editable third-party A/B testing scripts.

stories.headline: Semiconductor and data-centre equipment shipments propel Malaysia’s Q3 trade surplus beat
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 18 — Breakdown data accompanying BNM’s 5.5% Q3 GDP release showed electrical and electronics (E&E) exports surging on global AI server assembly and Penang OSAT demand.
takeaways: Penang and Kulim Hi-Tech Park recorded high capacity utilization across advanced packaging lines.
Economists raised full-year 2026 Malaysian GDP forecasts toward 5.4%–5.6%.

stories.headline: Ismail Lasim denies resigning as Negeri Sembilan Menteri Besar amid conflicting coalition statements
stories.summary: SEREMBAN, Nov 18 — Datuk Ismail Lasim publicly denied stepping down as Negeri Sembilan Menteri Besar, contradicting earlier announcements and setting the stage for the state palace’s intervention.
takeaways: Sparked urgent meetings among state Pakatan Harapan and Barisan Nasional assemblymen.
State administration operations continued normally pending palace review.

stories.headline: Merger filing reveals DoorDash agreed to $1.25B antitrust termination fee in $17B Instacart buyout
stories.summary: NEW YORK, Nov 18 — Regulatory filings for DoorDash’s $17 billion ($65/share) acquisition of Instacart revealed a $1.25 billion reverse breakup fee if the U.S. Department of Justice blocks the deal on antitrust grounds.
takeaways: Instacart would owe a $650M fee if it terminates the pact to accept a competing offer.
Deal faces multi-jurisdictional reviews in the US, Canada, and Israel through late 2027.

stories.headline: RTX’s Collins Aerospace breaks ground on regional propeller MRO facility in Bengaluru
stories.summary: BENGALURU, Nov 18 — RTX subsidiary Collins Aerospace broke ground on a multi-million-dollar propeller Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) hub at the Collins India Operations Center in Bengaluru.
takeaways: Will service regional turboprop and military transport fleets across the Asia-Pacific.
Reduces turnaround times for regional airline operators.

stories.headline: Ukraine scrambles repair crews after retaliatory Russian strikes hit Kyiv bridges and heating lines
stories.summary: KYIV, Nov 18 — Municipal utility crews worked round-the-clock in Kyiv to restore heating and water pressure after Russian retaliatory missile and drone strikes targeted the North and South bridges.
takeaways: Followed Ukraine's overnight drone strike that damaged a road arch on the Kerch Bridge.
European donors pledged emergency mobile gas turbines and transformers.

stories.headline: Near-Earth asteroid 2026 WA completes safe close flyby at one-third the lunar distance (126,400 km)
stories.summary: PASADENA, Nov 18 — Asteroid 2026 WA passed safely by Earth at a distance of 126,400 kilometers (roughly 0.33 lunar distances), tracked by planetary defense telescopes worldwide.
takeaways: Provided radar astronomy teams high-resolution trajectory and rotation measurements.
Coincided with dark pre-dawn skies for the annual Leonid meteor shower peak.

stories.headline: Umno Negeri Sembilan not informed of Ismail Lasim’s resignation plan, says Jalaluddin
stories.summary: SEREMBAN, Nov 17 — Negeri Sembilan Umno liaison chief Datuk Seri Jalaluddin Alias said the state chapter was not informed directly by Datuk Ismail Lasim about his intention to resign.
takeaways: Directly reported by Malay Mail.
Tap below for full in-depth reporting and official statements.

stories.headline: ‘Don’t make others the scapegoat’: Ismail Lasim’s son questions statement on father’s resignation
stories.summary: SEREMBAN, Nov 17 — The son of Negeri Sembilan Menteri Besar Datuk Ismail Lasim publicly questioned a statement issued regarding his father’s purported resignation.
takeaways: Directly reported by Malay Mail.
Tap below for full in-depth reporting and official statements.

stories.headline: Penang hopes for a portion of federal grant to reduce water infrastructure costs
stories.summary: GEORGE TOWN, Nov 17 — Penang chief minister Chow Kon Yeow appealed to Putrajaya for federal grant funds to help the state build critical water infrastructure and ease tariff pressure.
takeaways: Directly reported by Malay Mail.
Tap below for full in-depth reporting and official statements.

stories.headline: TM Tech gets green light for RM2.7b submarine cable project linking Peninsular Malaysia, Sabah and Sarawak
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 17 — Telekom Malaysia Bhd’s wholly-owned subsidiary TM Technology Services Sdn Bhd received approval for a RM2.7 billion submarine cable system linking Peninsular Malaysia, Sabah, and Sarawak.
takeaways: Directly reported by Malay Mail.
Boosts high-capacity domestic subsea fibre resilience across Malaysia.

stories.headline: ‘For most, the answer is no’: Baidu CEO casts doubt on AI’s immediate profit payoff
stories.summary: SHENZHEN, Nov 17 — Artificial intelligence adoption is not boosting bottom-line profits for most companies yet, the head of Chinese tech giant Baidu cautioned during tech discussions in Shenzhen.
takeaways: Directly reported by Malay Mail.
Warned enterprises to focus on concrete ROI rather than model hype.

stories.headline: Amanah man urges PAS to ditch Umno and back Anwar
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 17 — Amanah communications director Khalid Samad said Amanah is open to discussing PAS’s participation in the unity government if it prioritises constructive national policies.
takeaways: Directly reported by Free Malaysia Today.
Tap below for full in-depth reporting and official statements.

stories.headline: Mongolia president announces resignation after graft accusations
stories.summary: ULAANBAATAR, Nov 17 — Mongolian President Ukhnaa Khurelsukh announced his resignation a day after the opposition Democratic Party accused him of corruption and demanded he step down or face impeachment.
takeaways: Directly reported by Free Malaysia Today.
Triggered immediate parliamentary consultations on interim succession.

stories.headline: Ismail far more ethical than Zahid, says ex-Umno man Puad Zarkashi
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 17 — Unlike Ismail Lasim, Puad Zarkashi argued that certain political leaders want to keep their government posts while openly contradicting the unity administration.
takeaways: Directly reported by Free Malaysia Today.
Tap below for full in-depth reporting and official statements.

stories.headline: PM Anwar and French President Emmanuel Macron make unscheduled heritage visit to Sri Maha Mariamman Temple in KL
stories.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 17 — Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim and visiting French President Emmanuel Macron made an unscheduled cultural stop at the historic Sri Maha Mariamman Temple in Kuala Lumpur.
takeaways: Warmly welcomed by temple trustees and local crowds along Jalan Tun H.S. Lee.
Highlighted cultural diplomacy alongside bilateral trade and defense talks.

stories.headline: Trump arrives in Manila for 49th ASEAN and Quad summits ahead of Shenzhen APEC trip
stories.summary: MANILA, Nov 17 — U.S. President Donald Trump arrived in Manila for the 49th ASEAN Summit and the first Quad leaders summit since 2024, holding bilateral talks with Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
takeaways: Pushed the U.S.-led Pax Silica economic initiative in bilateral discussions.
Marked Trump's first overseas tour following U.S. midterm election losses.

stories.headline: Ukraine launches massive overnight drone barrage striking main road arch of Kerch Bridge
stories.summary: KYIV, Nov 17 — Ukraine launched one of its largest overnight drone assaults of the war, striking a main road arch of the strategic Kerch Bridge linking Russia to Crimea and halting vehicle traffic.
takeaways: Caused structural deformation on the road span and stranded thousands of motorists.
Coincided with difficult online peace talks involving U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner.

stories.headline: Third U.S. aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt joins 20-warship armada enforcing blockade on Iran
stories.summary: WASHINGTON, Nov 17 — The USS Theodore Roosevelt carrier strike group entered U.S. Central Command waters to join the USS George H.W. Bush and USS George Washington in enforcing a naval blockade on Iranian ports.
takeaways: Heavily restricts Tehran's maritime crude oil exports following stalled nuclear talks.
Paired with land-border enforcement under Task Force Iron Gate.

stories.headline: Japan PM Sanae Takaichi proposes ASEAN regional oil-stockpiling task force; COP31 expands carbon coalition
stories.summary: MANILA / ANTALYA, Nov 17 — At the ASEAN Summit in Manila, Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi proposed sharing Japan’s idle oil storage capacity with Southeast Asian neighbors, while the Philippines joined the Coalition to Grow Carbon Markets at COP31.
takeaways: Buffers ASEAN importers against Middle Eastern shipping bottlenecks.
COP31 coalition commits signatories to high-integrity private carbon finance standards.

stories.headline: OPTIMJACK supply-chain attack via Optimizely Web compromises 178+ major brands globally
stories.summary: LONDON, Nov 17 — Attackers injected malicious JavaScript into Project JS fields on Optimizely Web, serving card skimmers, crypto clippers, and iOS exploits via cdn.optimizely.com across 178 to 188 organizations.
takeaways: Affected high-profile sites including BBC, CNN, Zoom, HSBC, IKEA, Salesforce, and GitLab.
Included Coruna and DarkSword iOS exploit kits targeting iOS 18.6 and older.

stories.headline: U.S. Commerce Dept issues interim final rule closing remote-access cloud loophole for advanced AI chips
stories.summary: WASHINGTON, Nov 17 — The U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) issued regulations blocking foreign entities in Group D:5 nations (China, Russia, Iran, North Korea) from remotely renting advanced AI compute in third countries.
takeaways: Imposed new export licensing on advanced AI chips sent to Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Singapore, and Brazil.
Malaysian Nvidia partner YTL Power fell 5% as Bursa Malaysia tech counters reacted.

stories.headline: NEC and IBM Japan complete Japan’s first hybrid QKD and Post-Quantum Cryptography proxy demonstration
stories.summary: TOKYO, Nov 17 — NEC Corporation and IBM Japan announced the successful demonstration of hybrid quantum-safe communications integrating Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) with Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) proxy layers.
takeaways: Allows legacy enterprise applications to adopt quantum resistance without code rewrites.
Protects critical infrastructure against 'harvest now, decrypt later' interception.

stories.headline: Global markets brace for Nvidia Q3 FY27 earnings under interim CEO Colette Kress after Jensen Huang’s exit
stories.summary: NEW YORK, Nov 17 — Wall Street and Asian markets traded nervously ahead of Nvidia’s Q3 FY27 earnings report following co-founder Jensen Huang’s abrupt November 12 resignation and a $1.9T market-cap slide from peak.
takeaways: Nvidia's board explicitly ruled out reinstating Huang despite employee and tech executive petitions.
U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent publicly urged Nvidia to hire an external permanent CEO.

stories.headline: U.S. Department of Justice takes jurisdiction over antitrust review of DoorDash’s $17B Instacart acquisition
stories.summary: WASHINGTON, Nov 17 — The U.S. Department of Justice claimed authority to conduct the antitrust investigation into DoorDash’s proposed $17 billion ($65/share) takeover of grocery delivery rival Instacart.
takeaways: Consumer and grocer advocacy groups urged regulators to challenge the consolidation.
Agreement includes a $1.25 billion breakup fee if blocked on antitrust grounds.

stories.headline: IMF projects South Korea’s GDP growth accelerating to 3.9% in 2026 on record AI semiconductor exports
stories.summary: SEOUL, Nov 17 — Concluding its Article IV consultation, the International Monetary Fund forecast South Korea’s real GDP expanding 3.9% in 2026, powered by record high-bandwidth memory and AI chip exports.
takeaways: Contrasted with near-term equity volatility across Asian semiconductor indexes.
India's Sensex also edged up ~75 points as the Indian rupee firmed to 93.76/USD.

stories.headline: RBA minutes reveal majority support for fifth rate hike; Fed’s Michael Barr warns of AI market 'herding' risks
stories.summary: SYDNEY / MILAN, Nov 17 — Reserve Bank of Australia November board minutes showed a majority favored a fifth rate hike to combat sticky inflation, while Fed Gov. Michael Barr warned that identical AI models could trigger market herding.
takeaways: JPMorgan Chase and U.S. online banking platforms also experienced temporary access glitches.
FEMA and the FCC completed a routine nationwide U.S. Emergency Alert System broadcast test.

stories.headline: NASA invites world to flash 'V-G-R' in Morse code for 'Shine Bright for Voyager' ahead of one light-day crossing
stories.summary: WASHINGTON, Nov 17 — NASA launched global 'Shine Bright for Voyager' public events inviting skywatchers after sunset on Nov 17 to flash 'V-G-R' in Morse code toward interstellar space to honor Voyager 1.
takeaways: Marked the eve of Voyager 1 crossing 16.1 billion miles (one light-day) from Earth.
Celebrated nearly 50 years of continuous operation since September 1977.

stories.headline: University of Osaka physicists observe exotic 1D 'heavy fermion' quantum state at ytterbium-copper boundary
stories.summary: OSAKA, Nov 17 — Researchers at the University of Osaka observed electrons behaving with unusually heavy effective mass where a single atomic layer of ytterbium meets a copper substrate.
takeaways: Provides a new 1D experimental platform for studying unconventional superconductivity.
Published in leading condensed-matter physics proceedings.

stories.headline: MARUM scientists discover thousands of microscopic animals living inside deep-sea polymetallic nodules
stories.summary: BREMEN, Nov 17 — Marine biologists at Germany’s MARUM center discovered thriving microscopic ecosystems tucked inside the internal cracks and cavities of Pacific Ocean polymetallic nodules.
takeaways: Internal nodule fauna is completely distinct from surrounding seafloor sediment life.
Raises urgent ecological questions for commercial deep-sea battery-metal mining.

stories.headline: Univ. of Wollongong unveils world-first bioengineered cornea; 34-year study finds harvester ant colonies defy aging
stories.summary: WOLLONGONG / RIVERSIDE, Nov 17 — UOW researchers unveiled an intelligent-polymer bioengineered cornea to address global donor shortages, while a 34-year study of 3,285 harvester ant colonies found older colonies enjoy lower mortality.
takeaways: UC Riverside scientists also mapped how mitochondrial DNA damage from pollutants initiates chronic inflammation.
Bioengineered cornea aims to restore sight without relying on human donor eye banks.
